inputs.question: How many distinct reporting groups are there, after applying the catalog's reporting group rules to the product categories? Return an integer.

outputs.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rg.ReportingGroup) FROM Categories c JOIN (SELECT CategoryID, CASE WHEN CategoryName IN ('Grains/Cereals', 'Produce') THEN 'Pantry' ELSE NULL END AS ReportingGroup FROM Categories) rg ON c.CategoryID = rg.CategoryID WHERE date(c.desc) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-12-31'
